subject: Compliance impact matrix & proposed next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Park <dylan.park@clearwave-payments.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance impact matrix & proposed next steps

Dylan / Mina — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a single source of truth and a suggested set of next steps. Please correct me if I misunderstood anything.

Key pain points you mentioned:
- Audit log granularity: need immutable, per-tenant event logs (user id, request id, model id, timestamps, token-level metadata) for at least 24 months.
- Retention & eDiscovery: retention windows vary by product; legal requires ability to place holds and export logs for litigation/incident response.
- SOC 2 evidence: you need a recent SOC 2 Type II report for hosting & infra components used by Redwood for customer data.
- Pen test: procurement wants vendor pen-test results and a timeline to run a customer-facing security assessment.
- DPA and data residency: DPA redlines around subprocessor disclosure and deletion/return-of-data clauses.

Goals you stated:
- Complete security qualification by end of Q3 to be included in internal vendor list.
- Confirm data retention architecture and exportability for audit.
- Agree on a mutual action plan (MAP) with dates for SOC2, pen test scheduling, and DPA review.

Open clarifying items for ClearWave:
1) Can you confirm the minimum retention requirement per product (e.g., transactions: 24 months, support logs: 12 months)?
2) Any specific format for log exports (CSV, JSONL, SIEM ingest)?
3) Who will own the legal redlines for the DPA on your side (procurement or legal)?

Proposed next steps from our side:
- We will share a concise SOC 2 summary and the most recent report (redacted) by EOD tomorrow. (attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
- Draft MAP with approximate dates and owners — well send a first pass as a spreadsheet.
- Technical: engineering can prepare an architecture diagram and sample export of audit logs (JSONL) for your security team.
- Pen test: propose a vendor-led questionnaire and then schedule a vendor security call to scope an authorized pentest window (we suggest July/Aug window).

If that aligns, well proceed to populate the MAP and loop in our security engineer (Aditya) for the technical artifacts.

Thanks,
--
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0191
From: Dylan Park <dylan.park@clearwave-payments.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Cho <mina.cho@clearwave-payments.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance impact matrix & proposed next steps

Thanks, Tessa — that's an accurate summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: transactions = 24 months, support logs = 12 months, fraud-signals (high sensitivity) = 36 months. We need the ability to set per-tenant retention policies.
- Export format: JSONL with request_id and event_type fields preferred; SIEM-friendly schema is a plus.
- DPA: procurement will own commercial redlines; legal will review security clauses. I'll introduce our procurement lead on the next thread.

I've attached our current retention policy for reference (clearwave-data-retention-policy.pdf). Two asks we have immediately: 1) a short artifact list you can share now (SOC2 redacted, architecture diagram, pen test cadence), and 2) a proposed MAP with owners and dates so I can drive internal approvals.

Also, can Redwood confirm whether audit logs are immutable (append-only) and whether you support export during a legal hold? Thats the gating item for our compliance team.

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Park
Head of Compliance, ClearWave Payments
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Park <dylan.park@clearwave-payments.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Compliance impact matrix & proposed next steps

Dylan — appreciate the quick reply and the retention doc. Short responses to your asks and an attached MAP draft.

1) Artifact list (we will share): redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (redacted Type II), architecture-diagram.png, sample-audit-export.jsonl, pen-test-policy.pdf.
2) Audit logs: our runtime writes append-only audit events to an immutable object store with versioning and signed checksums; exports can be produced on demand for legal hold. We will include a short technical note on verification and chain-of-custody.
3) MAP draft: attached (mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx) with owners and suggested dates. High-level timeline: SOC2 artifacts and architecture diagram by 2027-06-17, sample export and technical note by 2027-06-21, procurement/DPA review targeted for 2027-07-01, pen-test scheduling to agree by 2027-07-10 with a window in late July.

Action items for ClearWave:
- Please confirm the per-product retention mapping (you provided a great start).
- Procurement: share the point of contact for DPA redlines.
- Security: please confirm preferred SIEM schema if you have one (we can map fields).

We will upload the artifacts to the shared MAP Drive and send the DocuSign link for a non-binding NDA so we can exchange redacted reports if needed.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
(attachment: mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx)

Subject: Re: Compliance impact matrix & proposed next steps

Karthik / Tessa — thanks for the MAP and the technical details. Ill: 
- Confirm retention mapping with product by Monday.
- Loop procurement (cc'd on next email) to own DPA redlines.
- Accept the Drive share and will request the NDA DocuSign if we need redacted SOC2 materials.

Were aligned on the pen-test cadence; will propose two preferred weeks in late July when procurement signs off. For the audit export, well share the SIEM schema next week so you can map fields.

Short answer: this looks good, please proceed with the artifact upload and Ill follow up with the contacts.

Thanks,
Mina Cho
Security Program Manager, ClearWave Payments
